data.title: Getting Started with TrainZilla | Help
data.description: Set up your coaching business on TrainZilla: complete your profile, bulk-import clients, define reusable habit templates, and add your first coach.
data.keywords: getting started TrainZilla, set up coaching business, onboard clients, bulk import clients, habit templates, add a coach

_rationale: Original setup checklist stopped at one coach, one plan; added bulk-import and 'add your first coach' so the onboarding page matches a trainer who's already scaling, not just starting solo.
